Product Details

Zellige Oat High Gloss Ceramic Tile by Villa is a rectangular wall tile that brings refined character to residential and commercial interiors. Its natural color, handmade look, and handcrafted look create a warm artisan surface with unique from tile to tile variation, uneven edges, and rich color variation and texture that elevate any design.

  • Pressed edges deliver a crisp finished line, helping each installation feel intentional, polished, and beautifully aligned on the wall.
  • High gloss finish reflects light elegantly, adding depth and brightness while making the surface feel more luxurious and visually expansive.
  • Handmade look creates an artisanal statement with unique from tile to tile variation, giving walls authentic charm and designer appeal.
  • Suitable for wall only installation, this tile is ideal for feature walls, backsplashes, and fireplace surrounds that need lasting style.
  • Indoor use makes it a versatile choice for bathrooms and kitchens, while shower wall safe performance adds confidence in wet areas.

Natural color pairs effortlessly with modern and classic palettes, while the 8mm profile supports a refined finish. Zellige Oat High Gloss Ceramic Tile offers timeless beauty with artisanal character for standout interiors.
